start.greeting: Send a video link to begin.
start.startup: ✨ {name} is up — paste a link to start a download.

format.invalid_selection: That button is no longer valid
format.session_expired: This request has expired — send the link again

progress.processing_generic: Merging and converting the downloaded media…

notice.cookies_rejected: Cookies were rejected and skipped — refresh them

reason.suspended_hint: The account that posted this has been suspended, so the media is no longer served by the site.
reason.private_hint: This content is private and cannot be accessed without permission from its owner.
reason.removed_hint: This content has been deleted or taken down and is no longer available.
reason.age_restricted_hint: The site only serves this to a signed-in adult account. Adding cookies for a logged-in account may help.
reason.login_required_hint: The site refused to serve this without an authenticated session. Add your cookies to fix it — see the Cookies section in the README.
reason.geo_blocked_hint: The site does not serve this content from the server's location.
reason.not_started_hint: This is an upcoming stream or premiere. Try again once it has started.
reason.members_only_hint: This is restricted to channel members. Cookies for a subscribed account are required.
reason.drm_hint: This site encrypts its media, so yt-dlp will not download from it. Spotify, Netflix, Disney+ and similar services all work this way.
reason.site_unsupported_hint: yt-dlp deliberately does not support this site and will not add it.
reason.subscription_hint: The account behind the cookies does not have access to this. A subscription or purchase is required.
reason.network_hint: The request never completed. This is usually temporary — try again shortly.
reason.no_media_hint: The link opens fine, but there is no video or audio in it to download.
reason.format_unavailable_hint: The chosen quality does not exist for this media. Try another one.
reason.rate_limited_hint: The site is temporarily refusing requests from this server. Wait a while and try again.
reason.unsupported_url_hint: yt-dlp has no extractor for this URL. Double-check the link is correct.
reason.not_found_hint: The site returned 404 for this link. It is likely wrong or already deleted.
reason.forbidden_hint: The site returned 403. It may require cookies or be blocking this server.
reason.unavailable_hint: The site reports this content as unavailable without giving a specific reason.

admin.not_admin: 🚫 This command is for admins only.
admin.invalid_user_id: ❌ That is not a valid ID — it must be a number.
admin.user_exists: ❌ User {user_id} is already in the config.
admin.user_deleted: ✅ User {user_id} removed. 💡 Written to the config and reloaded.
admin.user_not_found: ❌ User {user_id} is not in the config.
admin.cannot_delete_admin: ❌ {user_id} is an admin — remove them from the config by hand.
admin.config_usage: ❌ Usage: /config get <path> — read a value /config set <path> <value> — change one Examples: /config get telegram.max_upload_tasks /config set telegram.max_upload_tasks 10

ytdlp.new_version: New {channel} yt-dlp version available: {latest} Current version: {current} Rebuild the worker with ./redeploy.sh yt_worker
ytdlp.up_to_date: ℹ️ Your {channel} yt-dlp version {current} is up to date.
